attributes.residual: None, and the audit escape is gone with nothing replacing it - this is the strongest retirement of the run. THE FINDING: the note's DIAGNOSIS was exact ('raw addi/or copies attach to swapped destinations in the prologue (+0x28-0x44)') and its CONCLUSION was wrong ('the shipped shape-aligned permutation leaves a dataflow crossing'). The crossing was a property of the ORDER, not of the function: sending source atom 0 (`addi r27,r4,0`) to +0x34 and source atom 1 (`mr r28,r5`) to +0x40 instead of the reverse puts each copy under a target word with the SAME destination and SAME source, leaving a pure encoding difference at each that `unconditional` copy-form closes. AGENTS.md discipline 1 in its exact form: the diagnosis transferred, the prescription rotted.
